en.title: Hannah Waddingham's Game of Thrones Villain Role Before Ted Lasso Stunned Fans
en.summary: Years before charming audiences as Rebecca Welton on **Ted Lasso**, Hannah Waddingham delivered a chilling performance as a memorable villain on HBO's **Game of Thrones**. Her journey from stage actress to global television icon is a testament to her versatile talent.
en.body:
Before **Ted Lasso** made **Hannah Waddingham** a household name, the acclaimed actress honed her craft in a role that was a stark departure from the warm-hearted Rebecca Welton. Fans who only know her from the Apple TV+ hit might be surprised to learn that Waddingham once graced the halls of Westeros, playing the unnerving Septa Unella in HBO's monumental fantasy drama, **Game of Thrones**. Her portrayal of the devout and vengeful Septa, known for her relentless pursuit of atonement and her infamous "Shame!" chant, left an indelible mark on viewers, showcasing a darker, more formidable side of her acting prowess.

Waddingham's career, however, is built on a foundation far broader than these two iconic roles. With a background rooted in musical theatre, she spent years collecting award-winning performances on stage before transitioning to television. Her journey to stardom, as she herself has noted, was not an overnight sensation but rather the culmination of over 25 years of dedicated work across various mediums. Roles in shows like **Benidorm** and **Krypton** also contributed to her growing resume, demonstrating a consistent ability to adapt and excel in diverse genres. Her presence in **Game of Thrones** from 2015 to 2016, and later her Emmy-winning performance in **Ted Lasso** (2020–present), alongside significant parts in **Sex Education** and the upcoming **Ride or Die** series, paints a picture of an actress constantly challenging herself and delighting audiences with her range.

## A Tale of Two Characters
The juxtaposition of Septa Unella and Rebecca Welton is a fascinating study in an actor's ability to inhabit vastly different characters. While Septa Unella represented a rigid, almost fanatical adherence to a brutal system, Rebecca Welton evolved from a formidable antagonist seeking revenge to a complex, relatable figure grappling with her own vulnerabilities and finding genuine connection. This chameleon-like quality is precisely what makes Waddingham such a compelling presence on screen. Fans often discuss how actors they love in one role can surprise them with entirely different performances, and Waddingham's **Game of Thrones** stint is a prime example of this phenomenon, proving her capacity for both villainy and heartwarming charm.

## What's Next for the Star
**Hannah Waddingham's** star continues to ascend. Following the immense success of **Ted Lasso**, she has become a highly sought-after talent. Her upcoming role in the 2026 series **Ride or Die** is eagerly anticipated by fans eager to see her tackle new dramatic territory. With a career marked by such significant and varied roles, audiences are excited to see where her remarkable talent will take her next, solidifying her status as one of television's most captivating performers.

content_raw: Years before her Ted Lasso role as Rebecca Welton, Hannah Waddingham played a disturbing and unforgettable villain on HBO's Game of Thrones.
